Chad Gable is back in the full swing of things at WWE, returning to "SmackDown" this past Friday after being revealed as El Grande Americano Original following a mask vs. mask lost to El Grande Americano at AAA Noches de la Grandes. But it wasn't too long ago that Gable was on the outside looking in, attempting to recover from serious injury . On Friday, Gable posted a video on his YouTube channel discussing the injury , the first of what could be several episodes documenting Gable's last year.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3LiUm8n-tyI

After starting off by putting his injury into perspective compared to more serious issues, Gable began detailing how he first got injured, which was during a match with GUNTHER during a live event. Gable soon learned he suffered a slight tear in his right bicep, but that the injury wasn't serious enough to require surgery or keep him out of action. As such, he continued on, until more warning signs emerged that he was more injured than previously thought.

"Progressively, the right side specifically of my arm was giving me more and more trouble, and sometimes I couldn't extend my elbow all the way," Gable said. "Sometimes it hurt too. Sometimes I started having pain down here in the lower part of the bicep. And so eventually, I decided, you know, I better get this checked out, at least just for my sanity, so I know everything's okay. I got MRI's on my shoulder, my tricep, my bicep tendons involved in that too, to get a look at what's going on."

It was during this MRI, which Gable had done on both his arms, revealed a major shock. While his right arm wasn't as bad as he had thought, the rotator cuff on Gable's left shoulder was torn, requiring the surgery that kept him out of action.

"So it turns out all this time, I was so worried about my right side, and the left side was the one that had, you know, all these issues, to my surprise," Gable said."

Today was supposed to be the start of the WWE Shareholders lawsuit against Vince McMahon. The trial was scheduled to last one week and would have had McMahon, Ari Emmanuel, Nick Khan, and others testify about the deal to sell WWE to Endeavor, which then resulted in TKO Holdings and if it was fast tracked to keep McMahon in power, despite sexual misconduct allegations against him. McMahon and Khan were sanctioned by the judge ahead of the trial's scheduled start date. On Friday, it was reported that the trial was no longer on the Delaware Court of Chancery's calendar. On Sunday, Brandon Thurston confirmed that the trial had been canceled as a result of the parties coming to an agreement for settlement . The settlement will have to be approved by the court.

On Wrestling Observer Radio , Dave Meltzer provided some additional information regarding the settlement. He doesn't believe the settlement will be high enough to "hurt them in a way that's meaningful, I suppose." The figure of the settlement will come out at some point and he doesn't think there will be a fall guy. "One of the reasons they might have had to settle is because there could've been stuff that came out in the case where heads might have to roll." Meltzer believes that Khan would be the fall guy or they could blame McMahon since he's no longer with the company, but he doesn't think anyone will take the fall.

He notes that there may be something in the settlement that bars McMahon getting any of the settlement as WWE's largest shareholder. He also wondered if WWE's insurance would cover Paul Levesque, Nick Khan, George Barrios, and Michelle Wilson's part of the settlement payment since that is who they are employed by. Since McMahon is not, he's unsure if McMahon would have to pay separately.

The June 8 episode of WWE RAW went down in Paris, France at the Accor Arena. The night was full of big moments, and they started off the broadcast with a lot of noise.

Oba Femi had Brock Lesnar’s number after he beat the Beast at WrestleMania. Then Lesnar returned at Clash in Italy to destroy The Ruler with 7 F5s, 4 more than The Undertaker needed to break the streak .

Oba Femi kicked off the show this week, and fans were ready to hear from him. Fans were ready for The Ruler, and they gave him a great ovation, complete with chanting his name in massive fashion.

After opening up to say how great Paris is treating him, Oba Femi got down to business. He mentioned how Paul Heyman believes in spoilers, so Oba provided a spoiler that he will “run through every man in this King of the Ring tournament.” He plans on winning the whole thing at Night of Champions, and that is only the beginning.

Oba Femi will take his place as King of the Ring. He said this is not a prediction, it’s a spoiler. He also meant business as fans chanted on. Then he will claim another trophy, the head of Brock Lesnar. He plans on getting even with The Beast Incarnate, and then he said that the only thing he’s seen from Lesnar in the last few weeks was “a big bad bitch.”

After stating that he plans on settling the score with Brock Lesnar Dominik Mysterio came out to interrupt Femi. After all, next week will see Oba and Dirty Dom go one-on-one next week in the King of the Ring tournament. Dom said that Oba doesn’t rule anybody because he’s so worried about Brock Lesnar, but he should have been worried about Dirty Dom.

As Oba Femi was distracted, JD McDonagh jumped in the ring with a chair and whacked him. Oba didn’t flinch, and then Dom tried to get the jump on Oba, but The Ruler slammed him down before JD could save him. Oba Femi made it clear that Dominik Mysterio messed up as he said, “Rey Mysterio is your father, but next week I will introduce you to your daddy!”

articles.body_html:
Liv Morgan may be moving forward in the Queen of the Ring tournament on WWE RAW.

According to Fightful Select , all signs point to Morgan advancing, while another championship match is also expected to have a clear winner.

Liv Morgan is set to advance in the Queen of the Ring tournament during tonight’s RAW. She is scheduled for a fatal four-way qualifier against Becky Lynch, Alexa Bliss, and Chelsea Green. That would be a major win for Morgan, especially with Becky Lynch and Alexa Bliss also in the match.

There is also word on the Women’s Intercontinental Championship match. Sol Ruca is set to retain her title against Lyra Valkyria, keeping her reign alive on a loaded episode of RAW.

Those updates come after another spoiler pointed to Je’Von Evans advancing in the King of the Ring tournament. Evans is set to face Seth Rollins, Ricky Saints, and Talla Tonga, with Austin Theory and Bron Breakker expected to cost Rollins the match.

RAW will also feature Penta defending the Intercontinental Championship against Rey Mysterio. Oba Femi is scheduled to kick off the show after already advancing in the King of the Ring tournament.

The June 8 episode of WWE RAW airs live from Accor Arena in Paris, France, starting at 2 PM ET on Netflix. Ringside News will have live play-by-play coverage of the show in our WWE Monday Night RAW coverage hub.

Things can always change, but the current word is that Liv Morgan is set to advance in the Queen of the Ring tournament, while Sol Ruca is expected to retain the WWE Women’s Intercontinental Championship.

articles.body_html:
Bianca Belair is still away from the ring due to injury, but the EST of WWE has revealed she made a remarkable breakthrough in her recovery recently.

Belair took to her Instagram Story and revealed that her pregnancy has actually given her more time to focus on physical therapy for her injured finger. The WWE star shared a video showing that she can finally bend it again months after surgery.

“One thing about being pregnant… it’s really given me the time to get my finger better!!! We are still on therapy and We are bending!”

Belair underwent surgery earlier this year after the finger injury she suffered at WrestleMania 41 turned into a much bigger issue than expected . The injury involved a crushed knuckle joint, and the recovery ended up taking much longer than originally believed.

Bianca Belair’s February surgery kept her out of the ring, and her pregnancy has now extended that time away from WWE . Still, the EST of WWE’s latest update shows that she is making real progress with rehab.

Bianca Belair may be away from WWE right now, but she is using the time to heal properly before her eventual return. Between pregnancy and physical therapy, Belair is clearly focused on getting her body right for the next chapter.

articles.body_html:
Keith Lee has not appeared on AEW programming since 2023, but his name has not been completely off the table backstage.

In an update, Fightful Select reports that AEW sources confirmed Keith Lee was discussed for a return to programming a number of months ago. The update also noted that those plans have not come to fruition so far.

There were said to be tentative plans at the time, but if those plans had gone forward as originally intended, they would have already happened by now. It is also unclear whether those discussions ever made their way to Lee himself.

Lee has been absent from AEW since being pulled from the Worlds End pay-per-view in 2023. He later revealed that he had been dealing with an injury that had been lingering since 2022, and he has not wrestled for the company since.

Back in June 2025, Lee addressed his status after a fan reached out to wish him well. He made it clear that he was doing fine, but his return was not something he controlled.

“I am quite fine. It is not up to me when it comes to a return. But blessings to you as well.”

Lee also responded to a supporter who suggested launching a fan campaign to push for his return. He appreciated the concern, but said that was not necessary.

“I’ve been good for quite some time, though I do appreciate the concern. But no campaign required. Things happen the way they are suppose to, and eventually, the purpose will show itself.”

It was also noted that Lee has not been a regular backstage at AEW tapings, and there has been no word that he has been around to get cleared. That kind of process usually takes multiple weeks before a wrestler returns to television.

Lee’s last AEW match took place on Collision: Holiday Bash in December 2023, where he defeated Brian Cage. Since then, fans have continued asking when The Limitless One might finally return.

For now, the update is that AEW has at least talked about bringing Keith Lee back. Whether that turns into an actual return remains unclear, but his name has been part of internal discussions after more than two years away from AEW television.
